executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: laundry cost per resident day ($2.75) was 49% of the Connecticut median ($5.66). Ask how laundry is handled: by the home's own staff, by a contracted service, or with costs reported in another department.
Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $201.67 per resident day (47.8% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 2.1% (Connecticut median 2.5%).

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,133,729, $40.02 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $465,552 (41.1%), allocated fringe $99,569 (8.8%), non-wage costs $568,608 (50.2%). Raw food was $307,467 ($10.85 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $261,078.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $252,647, $8.92 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $187,308 (74.1%), allocated fringe $40,060 (15.9%), non-wage costs $25,279 (10.0%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $77,998, $2.75 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $77,998 (100.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2023 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
